blocks.text: CRUD ka matlab Create, Read, Update aur Delete hai; yeh database ke bunyadi kaam hain. Inhi se database mein rakha data sambhala jata hai (Figure 4.4 aur Table 4.1). Har database wali application CRUD operations par chalti hai; yeh maloomat ko durust aur taaza (up-to-date) rakhte hain. Python yeh kaam SQL commands se karta hai.

blocks.text: Figure 4.4 wala students table Python ki list mein, aur us par chaaron CRUD kaam bina database ke. Oopar ki qeematein badal kar Run karein aur dekhein ke table kaise badalta hai.

new_name = "Hina"   # Create: naye student ka naam
new_age = 19        # Create: naye student ki umar
update_id = 2       # Update: kis ID ki umar badalni hai
updated_age = 31    # Update: nayi umar
delete_id = 3       # Delete: kis ID ka record mitana hai

students = [
    {"ID": 1, "Name": "Ibrahim", "Age": 25},
    {"ID": 2, "Name": "Zainab", "Age": 30},
    {"ID": 3, "Name": "Kiran", "Age": 28},
]

def show(title):
    print(title)
    for row in students:
        print("  ", row["ID"], row["Name"], row["Age"])

show("Read (shuru mein):")

# Create (INSERT): naya record
next_id = max(row["ID"] for row in students) + 1
students.append({"ID": next_id, "Name": new_name, "Age": new_age})

# Update (UPDATE ... WHERE ID = update_id)
for row in students:
    if row["ID"] == update_id:
        row["Age"] = updated_age

# Delete (DELETE ... WHERE ID = delete_id)
students = [row for row in students if row["ID"] != delete_id]

show("Read (CRUD ke baad):")

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Oopar ki paanch lines: woh qeematein jo aap badal sakte hain (naya naam aur umar, kis ID ko update aur kis ko delete karna hai).
"students = [...]": table: har dictionary aik record (row) hai jis mein ID, Name, Age hain.
"def show(title):": Read: table ki har row print karta hai (SQL mein SELECT * FROM students).
"next_id = max(...) + 1" aur "students.append(...)": Create: sab se bari ID se agli ID (4) bana kar naya record aakhir mein jorta hai (INSERT).
"for row in students: if row["ID"] == update_id: row["Age"] = updated_age": Update: sirf us row ki umar badalta hai jis ki ID barabar ho, bilkul WHERE ki tarah.
"students = [row for row in students if row["ID"] != delete_id]": Delete: aisi nayi list banata hai jis mein woh row nahi jis ki ID delete_id hai.
Output: "Read (shuru mein):" ke neeche "1 Ibrahim 25", "2 Zainab 30", "3 Kiran 28"; phir "Read (CRUD ke baad):" ke neeche "1 Ibrahim 25", "2 Zainab 31", "4 Hina 19" (Kiran mit gaya, Zainab ki umar 31, Hina nayi).
Khud try karein: delete_id = 5 kar dein (aisi ID hai hi nahi): koi row nahi mitegi, jaise WHERE ID = 5 kuch nahi mitata.
